title: Back on the Bike After Being Hit by a Car 🚲 My First Commute Vlog
text:
I commute every day by bike, but in August I was hit by a car while riding home. This is the first ride on my Bianchi (which I commute on) since the accident.

It wasn't damaged significantly, but I suffered a bad concussion and have been working my way back to normal since. The bike and my head both had x-rays! No damage, but I was still nervous riding today.

Luckily the ride was largely uneventful, which in this case is the best kind.
